teaser.en: Slice a green okra pod and it turns silky in the pot, thickening coconut stews the way cooks on the coast like.
teaser.sw: Katakata ganda bichi la bamia na huwa laini kama hariri chunguni, likiufanya mchuzi wa nazi kuwa mzito kama wapendavyo wapishi wa pwani.
teaser.dg: Checha benda ra chijani, na nyunguni rinakala laini na ra luhe, rinahenda mtsuzi wa huwi ukale mzito dza vira ajiti a pwani anavyomendza.

summary.en: *Benda* is okra, an upright garden herb grown for its green ribbed pods. The pods are cooked in stews and with coconut.
summary.sw: *Benda* ni bamia, mmea mdogo uliosimama wa bustanini unaolimwa kwa ajili ya maganda yake ya kijani yenye mifereji. Maganda hupikwa katika michuzi na kwa nazi.
summary.dg: *Benda* (kpwa Chingereza *okra*) ni mmea uimao chocho wa busitani, unaorimwa kpwa sababu ya makakayage ga chijani genye mistari. Makakaya higa nkujitwa kpwenye mtsuzi na phamwenga na nazi.

about.en: *Benda* is an upright, leafy herb with large, lobed, slightly rough leaves. Its flowers are big and pale yellow with a dark red centre, like those of its relatives the hibiscus and cotton. Each flower gives way to a long, green, ribbed pod that tapers to a point. The pods are picked young and tender, and they release a slippery sap when cooked.
about.sw: *Benda* ni mmea mdogo uliosimama wenye majani mengi, majani yake ni makubwa, yaliyokatika kwa ndani na yanakwaruza kidogo. Maua yake ni makubwa, ya manjano hafifu yenye kiini chekundu kilichokolea, kama ya jamaa zake mbawaridi na pamba. Kila ua hufuatwa na ganda refu la kijani lenye mifereji linalochongoka kuelekea ncha. Maganda huchumwa yakiwa machanga na laini, na hutoa utomvu unaoteleza yanapopikwa.
about.dg: *Benda* ni mmea uimao chocho wenye makodza manji; makodzage ni makulu, gana mala, na ganakaraza chidide. Maruwage ni makulu, ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu, na kahi-kahi ni ga kundu sana, dza maruwa ga nduguze, *hibiscus* na pamba. Bada ya chila ruwa kunatuluka kakaya dzire ra chijani, renye mistari na ntsa. Makakaya nkungobolwa wakati ni maitsi na laini, na gachijitwa ganalavya luhe.

where.en: Okra is grown in home gardens on the south coast.
where.sw: Bamia hulimwa katika bustani za nyumbani katika pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Benda nkurimwa busitani za kaya pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: The pods are cooked in stews and with coconut.
uses.sw: Maganda hupikwa katika michuzi na kwa nazi.
uses.dg: Makakaya nkujitwa kpwenye mtsuzi na phamwenga na nazi.

names.en: The Digo name is *benda* (plural *mabenda*). Swahili calls it *bamia* or *binda*. In English it is okra or lady's fingers.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *benda* (wingi *mabenda*). Kwa Kiswahili inaitwa *bamia* au *binda*. Kwa Kiingereza inaitwa *okra* au *lady's fingers*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *benda* (unji: *mabenda*). Chiswahili chinariiha *bamia* au *binda*. Kpwa Chingereza rinaihwa *okra* au *lady's fingers*.

reason.en: Another slimy vegetable cooked in coastal stews
reason.sw: Mboga nyingine inayoteleza inayopikwa katika michuzi ya pwani
reason.dg: Mboga yanjina inayolavya luhe ichijitwa mtsuzi wa pwani.

reason.sw: Mboga nyingine ya bustanini ya kupikia mchuzi wa bizari
reason.dg: Mboga yanjina ya busitani ya kujitira mtsuzi.

reason.en: Its milk is what okra is cooked with
reason.sw: Tui lake ndilo hutumika kupikia bamia
reason.dg: Mnazi; huwi ya nazi ndiyo inayojitwa na benda.

mgombato: benda (ma) okra, lady's fingers; bamia, binda.
